verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships an official desktop app and a browsable self-hosted/hosted web app (docs-4, docs-8, comm-1/2), with features like meeting transcription and agents beyond basic chat (docs-3, docs-10), but there is no evidence of an official mobile app or any explicit statement of feature parity across surfaces. missing for 10: mobile app existence, explicit cross-surface feature-parity documentation, independent corroboration of parity beyond desktop polish anecdotes.
